title: Evidence tick marker fixed
details: Yellow evidence markers now use a filled yellow circle with a dark tick instead of the letter o
Evidence status is immediately recognisable and no longer looks like a zero
The same evidence tick is used consistently in KSB and NVQ AC coverage views
Installed copies receive a fresh v104 cache so the corrected native marker is loaded
summary: Evidence status now renders as a clear yellow tick directly from Evia instead of the old o/zero-style marker.
changes: Replaced the legacy o and o x count marker at its source with one clear yellow tick when evidence exists
Applied the same evidence tick to KSB and NVQ evidence coverage while keeping RPL and Milos observation markers unchanged
Refreshed the installed-app cache so v104 loads the corrected native evidence marker instead of the cached o marker
